title: 대규모 언어 모델을 활용하는 부적절 발언 탐지를 위한 추론 관점을 명시하는 소프트 귀납적 편향 접근법 (Soft Inductive Bias Approach via Explicit Reasoning Perspectives in Inappropriate Utterance Detection Using Large Language Models)

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating a model's accuracy and reasoning capabilities in classifying inappropriate utterances—specifically detecting texts driven by discrimination, hate, prejudice, and disparagement—using a Korean conversational dataset and Chain-of-Thought knowledge distillation.
